body:

[ATTS] For a moment i thought did vb the beer make tablets haha
[werdplaya58] Not anymore, I get an error when I try to add it.
[spock] Note these are about half the strength of the boxed packets .
[hypanthium] Great deal. I go through these pretty quickly.
Thanks OP.
[FiDad] Yes same. I have been using coles homebrand ones while waiting for deals on them
[prelude] The 40 packs are also on sale at Woolworths for $13 for anyone who doesn't have prime
[Ironic fear] Tbh almost every grocery item reduced on Amazon is the same price at Coles/Woolies/big W
Anything fulfilled by Amazon won't ship outside Perth in WA so having prime is pointless most of the year for me
[Cheezbrgr] Strawberry Kiwi still available at the same price
[ElectricMallet] Lemon lime also available for the same price
[Skinnerr] I got 4 of those gotcha4life boxes in May which had 3 packs of watermelon flavour plus another brand 'Lvl up' mixed berry x30 sachets that tastes amazing. Got like a decade supply of electrolytes for $80 plus tons of other decent back up toiletries. Those boxes were great value @$20.
[werdplaya58] 100% that was insane value. Hope it happens again next year.
[pavman] Thanks - still available.. lemon lime, strawberry kiwi and apple blackcurrant also still available
[topherboi] Can anyone recommend an affordable electrolyte that doesn't have sugar or artificial sweeteners?
Liquid I.V. seems to be well reviewed but is triple the price.
[rumblytangara] Sugar makes the electrolyte uptake process hugely faster, so unless you're somehow running low on electrolytes sitting in an air conditioned office (i.e. your diet is really weird) such a thing doesn't sound very useful.
